title: Changed-path impact seeds
responsibility: Classifies changed paths and converts them into graph seeds while flagging unbounded changes.

inputs.name: impactSeeds.changes
inputs.description: Added, modified or removed file changes to classify; removed paths use the base side.

inputs.name: impactSeeds.sides
inputs.description: Base and head snapshots providing workspace config and active unit ownership.

outputs.name: impactSeeds
outputs.description: Classified changes, graph seed ids, directly touched units and expansion reasons. Ignored paths produce no seeds; unit manifests seed their unit and owned files on both sides, scenarios seed their scenario, and global/other paths require expansion.
